note: B-S3 authored names (LAW §3). The dominance proposer (lib/dominance.mjs) finds each module boundary under a single-owner root; a person names it here. A decision is keyed by unit and the root's path relative to the unit at the time of the proposal. name: the dir's name (default: rootName). collapse: the dir folds into its parent dir. keep: the proposal is declined and every member stays where it lives, with the reason. rootAs: the root file's name inside its dir (a CSS aggregator becomes the dir's index.css door). Files the proposer would pull OUT of an existing authored dir are never moved (authored boundaries are kept); only members entering an accepted dir move. `authored` lists B's own carve where dominance finds no root (peer sets), each with its reason.

bases_note: LAW §4 base modules: for each parent dir whose child modules value-read a parent-level file, the one sibling module those files move to. Keyed by unit, then the parent dir relative to the unit (. = the unit root). The files are computed by derive/carve.mjs; only the name is authored.
